body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> Sony showcased its new egg-shape portable audio player 'Rolly SEP-10BT' during KES 2007. This egg-shaped music player can move back and forth, left to right and even spin with two rubber wheel. Measuring 65 x104mm at 300g, it is easy to carry anywhere you go. With a built-in 1GB memory, it can play Sony's exclusive file formats like ATRAC3 and ATRAC3plus as well as MP3 and AAC. Despite its compact size, it offers clear sound, Bluetooth capability and instinctive UI without the need for a screen. Powered by 1,560mAh Lithum battery, it can play up to 5 hours. After the KES 2007, Sony is expected to decide the launch of it in Korea market and suggested price is below 350,000(KRW).
